title: Cover direct-prompt source operation reads, operator pagination and reverse capacity admission
outcome: Behavior tests exercise retained source-operation reads and authorization, permission/reference listing through real page cursors, and existing wake reservations' impact on prompt admission under the finally agreed quota contract.
acceptance: Retained source-operation reads are covered through their real owner and reject a foreign caller.
Permission and reference lists exercise multiple pages without omission/duplication and reject foreign cursors.
Capacity isolation or sharing is tested in both directions according to the final coordinator-concurred quota contract.
